steps: Using a computer safely and responsibly protects your personal information and devices from harm.
It helps prevent viruses, data loss, and unauthorised access.
Responsible use also means treating others respectfully and following rules when using the internet.
items.finalAnswer: Safe and responsible computer use protects your information, devices, and other users.

steps: Choosing hardware and software that suit your needs helps you complete tasks effectively.
Suitable equipment and programs can improve a computer’s speed, performance, and ease of use.
Choosing unsuitable or incompatible products may cause problems, waste money, or prevent programs from working properly.
items.finalAnswer: The right hardware and software make a computer more useful, efficient, and reliable.

steps: Antivirus software detects, blocks, and removes viruses and other malicious programs.
It helps protect files and personal information and can prevent damage to the computer.
Keep antivirus software updated so it can recognise newer threats.
items.finalAnswer: Antivirus software helps detect and remove malware and protect your computer and information.

steps: Choose hardware and software according to your needs and budget.
Check that the hardware meets the system requirements of the software.
Buy products from trusted manufacturers or sellers and check reviews and support options.
Check that the software is genuine, secure, and compatible with your operating system.
items.finalAnswer: Choose suitable, compatible, secure products from trusted sources and within your budget.

steps: Compatible hardware and software are designed to work together.
This helps programs run properly and makes the computer more reliable and efficient.
It can reduce errors, crashes, and other technical problems.
items.finalAnswer: Compatibility helps hardware and software work together reliably and efficiently.

steps: Strong passwords make it harder for other people to guess or access your accounts.
Use a unique password for each account so that one stolen password does not put other accounts at risk.
A strong password should be long and include a mixture of letters, numbers, and symbols.
items.finalAnswer: Strong, unique passwords help prevent unauthorised access to your accounts.

steps: Software updates fix errors and security weaknesses in programs and operating systems.
They may also improve performance or add new features.
Install updates from trusted sources to help keep your computer secure and working properly.
items.finalAnswer: Regular software updates improve security, fix problems, and can add features.

steps: Do not open links or attachments from unknown or suspicious senders.
Check the website address before clicking a link, and use trusted websites for downloads.
Do not download or install files unless they are from a reliable source.
Keep antivirus software and your operating system updated.
items.finalAnswer: Avoid suspicious links and download files only from trusted sources.
